code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated RDW, monocytosis, basophilia, elevated ferritin, CRP, and INR, and mildly increased creatinine. These findings suggest possible acute or chronic inflammatory/infectious process, impaired oxygenation, and mild renal dysfunction. Hematologic abnormalities may indicate bone marrow suppression or systemic illness. Clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
